news.title: Mackie Samoskevich's late goal lifts Kraken over Mammoth 5-3
news.ruTitle: Поздний гол Маки Самоскевича поднял Кракена над Мамонтом со счетом 5-3
news.description: — Mackie Samoskevich scored with 5:25 left, and the Seattle Kraken, despite blowing a multiple-goal third-period lead for the second game in a row, beat the Utah Mammoth 5-3 on Thursday night.

news.title: Raymond scores twice in the Red Wings' 5-2 victory over the Canucks
news.ruTitle: Рэймонд забивает дважды в победе «Ред Уингз» над «Кэнакс» со счетом 5:2.
news.description: — Lucas Raymond scored twice and added an assist to help the Detroit Red Wings beat Vancouver 5-2 on Thursday night, sending the Canucks to their ninth straight loss.

news.title: Cooley makes 36 saves in the Flames' 2-1 victory over the Wild
news.ruTitle: Кули сделал 36 сейвов в победе «Флэймз» над «Уайлд» со счетом 2:1.
news.description: — Devin Cooley made 36 saves and the Calgary Flames scored two power-play goals in the first period in a 2-1 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Thursday night.

news.title: Roope Hintz scores overtime breakaway goal after tying game late as Stars beat Jets 3-2
news.ruTitle: Руп Хинц забил гол в отрыве в овертайме после ничьей в конце матча, когда «Старз» обыграли «Джетс» со счетом 3–2
news.description: — Roope Hintz scored on a breakaway 3:47 into overtime after his game-tying goal with 2 minutes left in regulation and the Dallas Stars beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-2 on Thursday night.

news.title: Barron's 4-point night powers Blues past Golden Knights, 6-2
news.ruTitle: 4-очковый ночной гол Бэррона помог "Блюз" обыграть "Голден Найтс" со счетом 6-2.
news.description: — Justin Barron had a goal and three assists, Dylan Holloway had two goals and an assist and the St. Louis Blues beat the Vegas Golden Knights 6-2 on Thursday night.

news.title: Artemi Panarin scores twice and the Kings beat the Islanders in OT for a 2nd straight win
news.ruTitle: Артемий Панарин забивает дважды, а «Кингз» обыграли «Айлендерс» в овертайме и одержали вторую победу подряд
news.description: — Artemi Panarin had two goals, Brandt Clarke scored in overtime and the Los Angeles Kings won a second consecutive game, 3-2 at the New York Islanders on Thursday night.

news.title: Stecher scores late goal to lift the Maple Leafs past the Rangers, 5-4
news.ruTitle: Стечер забил поздний гол и вывел «Мэйпл Лифс» на победу над «Рейнджерс» со счетом 5–4.
news.description: — Troy Stecher scored with 26.3 seconds left in regulation and the Toronto Maple Leafs outlasted the New York Rangers 5-4 on Thursday night for their third straight victory.

news.title: Sharks beat the Senators 6-2 for their 1st regulation victory of the season
news.ruTitle: «Шаркс» обыграли «Сенаторз» со счетом 6–2 и одержали свою первую основную победу в сезоне.
news.description: — Colin Graf had a goal and an assist, Yaroslav Askarov stopped 39 shots and the San Jose Sharks beat the Ottawa Senators 6-2 on Thursday night for their first regulation victory of the season.

news.title: Silovs, Penguins blank Panthers 4-0 to spoil Florida goalie Cooper Black’s record-setting NHL debut
news.ruTitle: Силовс и «Пингвинз» разгромили «Пантеры» со счетом 4:0 и испортили рекордный дебют вратаря «Флориды» Купера Блэка в НХЛ
news.description: — Pittsburgh's Arturs Silovs stopped 25 shots to spoil the history-making debut of Florida counterpart Cooper Black as the Penguins...

news.title: Michael DiPietro has first career shutout, David Pastrnak scores 2 as Bruins beat Predators 6-0
news.ruTitle: Майкл ДиПьетро впервые в карьере забил гол, Давид Пастрняк забил 2 гола, а "Брюинз" обыграли "Предаторз" со счетом 6-0.
news.description: — Michael DiPietro made 28 saves for his first career shutout, David Pastrnak had two goals and two assists, and the Boston Bruins cruised to a 6-0 victory over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.

news.title: Gritsyuk and Hischier score in 1st period in the Devils' 4-1 victory over the Ducks
news.ruTitle: Грицюк и Хишир забивают в первом периоде победы «Дьяволов» над «Дакс» со счетом 4:1.
news.description: — Arseny Gritsyuk and Nico Hischier scored first-period goals, Nico Daws made 16 saves and the New Jersey Devils beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-1 on Thursday night.

news.title: Panthers' Cooper Black, all 6-9 of him, becomes NHL's tallest goalie
news.ruTitle: Купер Блэк из «Пантерз» (всего 6–9 игроков) стал самым высоким вратарем НХЛ
news.description: The 6-9 Cooper Black is listed 2 inches taller than the goalies who previously held the mark -- Ben Bishop, Ivan Fedotov, Mads Sogaard and Mikko Koskinen.
